title: Triton Inference Request
description: An inference request submitted to NVIDIA Triton Inference Server following the KServe V2 inference protocol. Contains input tensors, optional output specifications, and inference parameters for sequence handling, priority, and timeout control.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inference request. If not provided, the server generates one.

parameters.description: Optional request-level inference parameters for controlling execution behavior

sequence_id.description: Identifier for the sequence this request belongs to, used with stateful models

sequence_start.description: Indicates this request is the first in a sequence

sequence_end.description: Indicates this request is the last in a sequence

priority.description: Priority level of the request. Higher values indicate higher priority.

timeout.description: Timeout in microseconds for the inference request

binary_data_output.description: If true, outputs will be returned as binary data appended to the response body

inputs.description: Input tensors for the inference request

outputs.description: Requested output tensors. If omitted, all model outputs are returned.

InputTensor.description: An input tensor for inference containing the tensor name, shape, data type, and data values

name.description: Name of the input tensor matching the model's expected input name

shape.description: Shape of the input tensor as an array of dimension sizes

datatype.description: Data type of the tensor elements

binary_data_size.description: Size in bytes of binary tensor data appended after the JSON body

shared_memory_region.description: Name of the shared memory region containing tensor data

shared_memory_offset.description: Byte offset within the shared memory region

shared_memory_byte_size.description: Size of the tensor data in shared memory in bytes

classification.description: Number of top classification results to return

data.description: Tensor data as a flattened row-major array of values

RequestedOutput.description: Specification for a requested output tensor

name.description: Name of the output tensor to return

binary_data.description: If true, return this output as binary data

shared_memory_region.description: Name of the shared memory region for output storage

shared_memory_offset.description: Byte offset within the shared memory region

shared_memory_byte_size.description: Size of the output in shared memory in bytes

classification.description: Number of top classification results to return
